Description: Start-up banner prints the four demo usernames and passwords.
Recommended action: Accepted for marking; remove or hide the banner before any real use.

Description: Without a real terminal (IDE console, piped input) the password prompt falls back to normal text input, so an IDE can show the password.
Recommended action: Run in a real terminal (documented in the environment); add a warning line when the fallback is used.

Description: The 1,000,000 capacity limit is enforced only by CourseView; CourseService accepts 1,000,001.
Recommended action: Move the upper limit into CourseService so every client gets the same rule.

Description: Course IDs are case-sensitive ('c1' is unknown) while usernames are not.
Recommended action: Normalise course IDs to upper case in CourseService.getCourse.

Description: Exit options differ: '0 Log out' (learner, instructor), '3. Log out' (administrator), '2. Back / exit' (login).
Recommended action: Use one convention in all menus.

Description: The 'Capacity:' prompt does not state the 1 to 1,000,000 range until a wrong value is entered.
Recommended action: Show the range in the prompt.

Description: When input ends in the middle of a form, the controller first reports 'Input stream closed.' as a failed action, then the program exits at the next prompt.
Recommended action: Let IllegalStateException for end of input pass through the controllers to Main.

Description: Accounts, courses, enrolments and lockout state are in memory and reset when the program restarts.
Recommended action: Out of scope (no persistence in the Part A module); listed in Scope.

Found by: AUTH-04, AUTH-06; review against OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet
Description: The lockout message differs from the generic failure message, and unknown usernames never lock. Three wrong passwords therefore reveal whether a username exists (account enumeration).
Recommended action: Show the generic message for locked accounts too, and record the lock internally.
